headline: CTS Corporation Completes $50 Million Acquisition of Millar Holdings
summary: CTS Corporation closed its $50 million purchase of Millar Holdings, integrating proprietary medical pressure-sensing technologies with additional earnout payments contingent on achieving future financial goals.
why: CTS designs and manufactures sensors, actuators, and electronic components for aerospace, industrial, and medical device manufacturers globally.

impacts.name: CTS Corp
impacts.why: Acquiring Millar expands CTS's specialized medical sensor portfolio and addressable healthcare market.
